cases.why: fitTables stops calling setScrollStop for table wrappers, so a wide table on a phone scrolls sideways with no way in from the keyboard -- the five axe findings come back.
the formula block is left out, so the ridge formula on Method scrolls with nothing to focus -- one of the five boxes axe found.
a box that fits keeps its tabindex, so after a rotate to landscape every table is a Tab stop that does nothing when you land on it.
fitting removes every attribute the function could have added, including a role, label or tabindex the markup set itself.
a box whose own controls already reach every column (the Power Ratings headers) gets a second, pointless Tab stop in front of them.
the name search looks inside earlier siblings, so the Accuracy calibration table is announced as 'Not enough games yet to check' -- the heading of a note, not of the table.
cases.replace: const hd = sib.matches('h2, h3, h4') ? sib : [...sib.querySelectorAll('h2, h3, h4')].pop(); if(hd) return hd;

cases.why: data-scroll-label is ignored, so Model Lab's experiment log is announced under the reliability diagram's heading.
the focus ring is dropped, so Tab lands on a table with nothing on screen to say so (WCAG 2.4.7).
